answer: Because the nadir ledger tracks the vesting curve, the island audit publishes how much each key actually received. Running aliases in rotation as a result never collects the full amount on any of them, because each one needs to survive the whole pigment schedule. Rewards vest linearly over 6 epochs and stop vesting the moment the identity is slashed, so an operator that gets caught forfeits the unvested remainder rather than just the current payment. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
